title: Leader backgrounds name no employers or verifiable details
what_happened: I found the two principals, Amber Baird and Jimmy Mitchell, with photos and decent bios. But Jimmy's "Previously" line just says "Large transformation program and team buildouts, strategic vision development" with no company named, and Amber's only says "a UPS logistics startup". I can't see a LinkedIn link either, so I can't check any of it before my call.
expected: For each principal, name at least one past employer or role, and add a LinkedIn link, so I can confirm the background before I put my practice's name next to theirs.

title: Resources promises case studies but is empty
what_happened: The Resources page says "Case studies, articles, and perspectives", then underneath it just says "No articles published yet. Check back soon." That's exactly what I came looking for. A heading promising case studies with nothing under it looks worse than having no page at all, and it's my fear about a polished site with nothing behind it.
expected: At least one or two short case studies saying what kind of client it was, what the problem was, what they did, and what changed, with a number or a date. If there aren't any yet, hide the page or drop "case studies" from the heading.

title: No past work, client names or results anywhere on the site
what_happened: I went through Home, About Us, What We Do and Resources. The home page just repeats the services and process from What We Do. Nowhere do I find a client, a sector example with a result, a testimonial, a number or a date. The only concrete work I can see is in the principals' own bios from previous jobs.
expected: Somewhere, even one short line per project, I want to see the kind of client, what was done, and what changed (for example "a 200-person logistics firm cut month-end close from 10 days to 4"). Then I could judge whether my clients would be a fit.
